people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: “ ‘This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before Yahweh, before the altar.
translations.bsb: Now this is the law of the grain offering: Aaron’s sons shall present it before the LORD in front of the altar.
translations.kjv: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.
translations.asv: And this is the law of the meal-offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before Jehovah, before the altar.
